DogSpeak: A Canine Vocalization Classification Dataset
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

DogSpeak is a large-scale, "in-the-wild" canine vocalization dataset designed to advance research in animal communication and computational bioacoustics. Unlike previous datasets recorded in controlled environments, DogSpeak is sourced from tens of thousands of online social media videos, capturing a wide array of natural, organic interactions.
